rules.rule: AGENTS.md and .agents/skills/ are the canonical instruction and skill sources. Each skill under .claude/skills/ must mirror the canonical skill's name and description and only refer to its .agents/skills/ source; flag full skill instructions duplicated under .claude/skills/ or a name/description mismatch.
bin/foreman must call core modules in src/ instead of duplicating lifecycle logic. bin/foreman-herdr and bin/foreman-paseo only set FOREMAN_BACKEND for one CLI process.

Canonical state mutations under FOREMAN_HOME must hold the home lock, and every active JSON record must be versioned and identity-bound. Flag writes to data/ that bypass the lock or skip version/identity checks.
Herdr-specific transport code stays in adapters/herdr/ and src/herdr.js. An assignment stays bound to its selected backend; flag silent backend fallback or cross-backend behavior in core.
Remote homes, relay channels, runtime backends beyond Herdr and Paseo, PR delivery, and merge authority are deferred. Flag any such feature added to core without an accepted specification in SPEC.md.
Original briefs, decisions, worker reports, and evidence must be preserved. Flag code that overwrites or deletes them, and liveness logic that infers a dead worker from unknown evidence.
Behavior changes to the CLI or state model must update SPEC.md, docs/architecture.md, or docs/runbook.md where they describe that behavior, and ship with tests under test/.
In Markdown files, each complete sentence should be on its own line. Flag newly added paragraphs that put several sentences on one line.

GitHub Actions workflows must declare top-level permissions with the minimum scope (default contents: read), set persist-credentials: false on actions/checkout unless the job pushes, pin third-party actions to a commit SHA, and must not use pull_request_target with a checkout of PR code.
